name: loop-budget
instructions:
Keep an agent loop inside its declared budget and end it with a typed verdict instead of a runaway process. Use when a repair, polling, or fan-out loop must declare step/cost/wall-time budgets up front, detect degenerate repetition and ping-pong, and exit with {exitStatus, submission, budgetSpent, nudges}.

Capabilities:
- declare loop budgets up front
- detect degenerate loops (repeats, ping-pong, format errors)
- record an append-only loop ledger and route on the typed verdict

Canonical skill: .agents/skills/delivery/loop-budget/SKILL.md
handoff_description: Budget declared, loop executed, and the run ended with a typed LoopBudgetVerdict plus an append-only ledger; the caller routes on exitStatus.
